title: Eye for an Eye (miniquest)
start: Talk to Ichi on the eastern side of Cyclosis. (Quartermaster Gully, south-east of the Port Sarim pub, can sail you to Cyclosis in the Arc region of the Wushanko Isles.)
prereq_other: Discover the island of Cyclosis in player-owned port

items.t: 30 sea salt or alaea sea salt (untradeable)

rewards.t: Banky crablet and Cyclosis teleport tablet unlocked in the Waiko Reward Shop

steps.t: Talk to Ichi on the east side of Cyclosis island (if you have just completed the Jed Hunter miniquest you may need to relog for the chat option to show up). [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Lookout Ekahi again, in the centre of the island.
Talk to See in the south-west corner of the island. [Chat: 1 Do you know anything about zyclopes?]
Mine 30 sea salt crystals from the salty crabletines on the north-west beach if you don't have them already.
Talk to Sinuman in the north-east corner for a bag of crushed salt. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Daya on the west side of the island to receive a bag of blessed salt. [Chat: 1 Do you know anything about zyclopes?]
Return to Ichi east on the island. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Go along the northern coast and speak to Undead Jed. Do not click anywhere until Undead Jed becomes attackable.
p: The boss fight with Undead Jed.

steps.t: Talk to Lookout Ekahi again. [Chat: 1 Eye for an Eye miniquest.]

get_inside.text: Players can unlock the ability to travel to Cyclosis by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim, or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals and has completed the Cyclosis voyage within the player-owned port.
Cyclosis teleport - Players may break this teletab to teleport to the merchant district of Cyclosis. It can be purchased at Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes.
